title: HERBALIFE LTD. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: Herbalife Ltd. filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 announcing preliminary Q1 2026 results, a proposed $800 million senior secured notes offering, and a conditional full redemption of its existing $800 million 12.250% Senior Secured Notes due 2029 at a price of $1,061.25 per $1,000 principal.
key_points: Herbalife announced preliminary Q1 2026 fiscal results via press release (Exhibit 99.1) on April 14, 2026
Company proposed $800 million aggregate principal amount senior secured notes offering via private placement to qualified institutional buyers
Proposed new notes offering is conditioned upon completion of one or more debt financing transactions
Company issued conditional full optional redemption notice for $800 million 12.250% Senior Secured Notes due 2029
Redemption price set at $1,061.25 per $1,000 principal plus accrued and unpaid interest
Redemption conditioned on receiving at least $800 million gross proceeds by April 29, 2026
Filing signed by CFO John DeSimone on April 14, 2026
